items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Was this with the Will Mastin trio?

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Well you know, when I played there with Cab – Jack Entratter, he’s the one who had the sands, and the – the dunes. They were more, you know – I went there – for the NAACP I had to drive with the president of the NAACP from Pasadena, he lived in Pasadena, he was the president of the NAACP there. Sammy Davis and I were to play this big thing for the NAACP. Sammy decided about a week or two before that he was not going to be able to make that. So they were – the NAACP said, “What can we do, Gerald?” I…
Was this with the Will Mastin trio?

Yes, the Will Mastin trio. That’s right. So I knew Sammy very well. So we drove to Vegas, we went to the sands, and I got through the door and I said, “We’re here to see Sammy Davis.” So the guy was very nice – Jack Entratter’s reputation was a nice man about those kinds of things. He took me on back to Sammy’s room, Sammy and I talked, I said, “Sammy, look. The NAACP is depending on you to be there for this thing. Don’t let them down.” Sammy said, “Alright Gerald.” I said, “Okay.” So we went on back – we went on…
